events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) grasps Sabonis's (SAC) arm and Sabonis places a hand on his body in response. Gobert accentuates the contact as he moves through the lane, but the marginal contact does not affect his FOM.
Sabonis (SAC) extends his hands into Edwards (MIN), affecting his driving shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) reaches across Monk (SAC) for the ball but the contact with Monk's front is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) brushes Monk's (SAC) right arm as he contests the driving shot attempt but the contact is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) begins to roll following the pick and steps on Sabonis's (SAC) foot while he is in a legally obtained position. Gobert falls to the floor as a result of the incidental contact.
Monk (SAC) swings his arm into Reid's (MIN) back, initiating more than marginal contact during the driving shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) commits a take foul on Monk (SAC) before the start of his shooting motion.
Conley (MIN) commits a take foul on Monk (SAC).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Monk (SAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. McDaniels (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and there is no proximate foul on the play.
Clark (MIN) commits a take foul on Sabonis (SAC).
Ellis (SAC) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making illegal contact with Edwards' (MIN) arms.
